hero.intro: One year of hands-on experience building web and mobile applications end to end and shipping them to production.

manifesto.label: Approach
manifesto.body: I have worked on a wide range of projects: AI-powered SaaS, education, logistics and interactive platforms. I take part in every stage of development, from frontend to backend, and care about clean architecture, high performance and user experience.

about.label: About
about.title: A software engineer who solves real problems with code.
about.bio:
In software development I care about more than features that work: system architecture, performance, reliability and code quality matter just as much. I fix technical problems at their root cause and build solutions that are easy to maintain and extend.

I have worked on products that are live with real users, building experience across frontend, backend and system integration. I pick up new technologies quickly and enjoy putting them to work on real problems.
